data.title: Fix flat rendering of list --tree and list --next for legacy parent refs
data.description: PR #113 introduced per-ref Active/LastUpdated/UpdatedBy on ParentIssueRef but System.Text.Json source-gen does not honor the = true initializer on Active. Legacy JSONL parent refs (missing the new fields) deserialize with Active=false and disappear from Issue.ActiveParentIssues, collapsing tree/next rendering to a flat list. Fix: auto-run Migration.Migrate in FleeceService.LoadAndNormalizeAsync.
